events.title: Flight Date | Steam Next Fest Demo Gameplay
events.summary: How hard can it be to bring people together? ✈️Flight Date is a cozy logic puzzle that turns seemingly simple meetups into absurdly complicated travel plans!Join us during Steam Next Fest for a look at the gameplay. 💜 The free demo is available now! Give it a try and let us know what you think!About this broadcast: This is pre-recorded demo gameplay playing on a loop, not a live gameplay session.

events.title: Meet Chirp Chirp Games 🐥 The Story of the Flight Date
events.summary: Hi! After the demo launch, we received more support than we could have imagined. We gathered lots of feedback on the demo and got to know so many lovely people. So far, we’ve mostly been talking about Flight Date, and we thought it was finally time to introduce ourselves too.So… hi. We’re Chirp Chirp Games!Flight Date actually started as a game jam project earlier this year. events.title: Mac Support Is Here — Playtest Ends on Sunday! 🍎
events.summary: Great news, we’ve added Mac support to the Flight Date Playtest!Mac players can now download the playtest directly from their Steam Library and join in.We’ve also extended the playtest, and it will remain open until Sunday, July 26.Your feedback is valuable for us because we're so close to releasing the demo! Thank you to everyone who has played and shared feedback so far.— Chirp Chirp Games ✈️

events.title: Playtest #2 Starts July 18! ✈️
events.summary: The Flight Date Playtest Begins July 18! (with a delay)edited: Sorry everyone, we have one day delay with the release. The version is not stable yet, we have some bugs that we know of, we don't wat to bother you with those. Therefore, we decided to release it on Saturday. Thank you for your patience with us.We’ve been working on a new version of Flight Date based on the feedback from our first playtest, and we’re finally ready to share it with you!The next playtest session will begin on:Saturday
